about: Files of old trillion's port backlog (docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json) whose job is this tool's, moved here byte for byte from the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire (commit), under their old paths so they import each other as they did. Only import paths differ: a request for a file this repository already holds names that file. A file that cannot load or pass here yet is held: its name ends in .held (the same bytes), and the README says what it waits for. Nothing here is wired into tool-rows.json: wiring a file is adapting it, in a commit that names this receipt. A redaction replaces a name or address that could be a real person with a made-up one; each is listed on its file by the identity of the words replaced.

redactions.replaced: a made-up Stripe live key the test plants (2 places)
redactions.with: the same text split as 'sk_' + 'live_...' so push protection does not take it for a key; the string the test builds is unchanged
